verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade into his Parrrley poke and let his Raise Morale buff stack free value; you win if you use Death's Grasp to close distance and force isolated duels with Realm of Death from level 6 on.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's lane plan is Parrrley poke (5s cooldown) plus Grog-Soaked Blade poison stacking on autoattacks, and he has no dash or hard CC to escape Mordekaiser's pull or ultimate once either lands. The measured head-to-head sits close to even at 49.4% over 2108 games, but Morde holds both the lane and solo-kill advantage because forced extended trades and isolated 1v1s punish GP's kite-and-poke plan.

theirWindow.when: right after he fires Raise Morale (E)
theirWindow.what: He and nearby allies gain bonus attack damage and move speed for the duration, so his autoattacks and Parrrley trades hit harder than normal — back off and just farm under the poke instead of contesting.

yourWindow.when: once his Raise Morale (E) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: His damage output drops to baseline Parrrley poke with no buff behind it. Close the gap with Death's Grasp (E) to pull him in, then land Obliterate (Q) point-blank where its damage is highest against a single target.

start.why: Runs at 49.9% WR over 1057 games and directly counters a lane built on autoattack chip (poison passive) and Parrrley poke by regenerating the damage back.

boots.why: Picked in 83.2% of games at 49.5% WR; flat reduction on his autoattacks and Parrrley hits is the single best defensive buy against an AA-reliant poke champion.

core.why: The slow on Obliterate and Death's Grasp turns both abilities into lockdown tools, making it harder for Gangplank to walk out of pull range before Realm of Death is ready.
Omnivamp sustains through poison DOT trades, and the true-damage proc rewards the extended fights you're forcing.
Standard 11.2%-pick finisher (49.2% WR) that stacks burn damage on top of the slows from Rylai's for isolated duels.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the extended melee trades you're forcing with Death's Grasp and point-blank Obliterate hits, stacking through the duel instead of a single poke exchange.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick at 75.6% and converts your measured solo-kill advantage into early kills once you land a Death's Grasp pull. Flash+Teleport (11.9% pick) is the alternative if you plan to prioritize scaling and side-lane split push instead.

playing.title: Hold back during his E buff
playing.detail: The moment he fires Raise Morale, he and nearby allies gain attack damage and move speed. Don't commit a trade into that window — just farm behind minions until it expires.

playing.title: Trade right after his Parrrley
playing.detail: Parrrley is on a 5-second cooldown. Bait it out, then close with Death's Grasp to pull him in before he can fire another.

playing.title: Center Obliterate on him alone
playing.detail: Obliterate's damage is increased when it hits a single enemy, so land it directly on Gangplank rather than splitting it across minions during an all-in.

playing.title: Pop Indestructible to out-sustain poison
playing.detail: Indestructible stores both damage dealt and damage taken into a shield you can consume to heal — use it mid-trade to erase the chip from his autoattack poison.

playing.title: All-in the instant R unlocks
playing.detail: At level 6, Realm of Death drags him into an isolated duel and steals a portion of his stats. He has no dash, and Remove Scurvy only clears crowd control — it doesn't let him leave the realm.

playing.title: Play passive before you have E
playing.detail: Before Death's Grasp is up, you have no way to close distance on his poke. Stay behind minions and eat Parrrley chip rather than walking up.

playing.title: Shift to split push once items spike
playing.detail: Once Rylai's and Riftmaker are online, your 1v1 damage and sustain outscale his kite plan — press side lanes and force him to answer.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, and all win rates are pulled from measured Mordekaiser vs Gangplank games on the current patch (16.19.1); the read on Raise Morale's buff window and the ultimate's kill timing is my own tactical judgment, not a measured stat.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being punished by Gangplank’s (E). Focus on farming lane while engaging combat whenever he steps in range of [E].
